units.function: Install-source path guard that canonicalizes local directories and restricts cloud-managed installs to real paths strictly beneath the bundled plugin catalog.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends on filesystem realpath/stat, path-relative containment, the Loader's bundled-root constant and cloud-instance environment detection; the plugin route must invoke it in the correct sequence.
units.keyDataModels: Managed-instance boolean and a success/failure canonical-path result with human-readable reason.
units.lifecycle: Rejects null/missing/non-directory paths, resolves symlinks and traversal, canonicalizes the catalog root and decides segment-based containment before Loader invocation.
units.testAssessment: All fifteen pure guard cases passed. They cover core canonicalization and containment well but omit TOCTOU/content mutation, nested symlinks/entrypoints, immutable digests, platform mount/case behavior and route sequencing.
units.designRationale: Treat plugin installation as an RCE boundary on managed infrastructure and fail closed based on an unforgeable deployment-harness environment marker.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs deployment-profile install policy plus a content-addressed trust decision that remains valid through verification, migration and execution on managed or customer-owned nodes.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the realpath-plus-path.relative containment and fail-closed profile tests into a narrow PackageSourcePolicy. Bind approval to immutable bytes/digest, realpath every nested artifact, stage read-only content and keep the policy independent of Loader implementation constants.
units.responsibilityConflict: A directory under a trusted root is treated as trusted content without signer, digest, approver, evidence or post-check immutability; self-hosted authority is implicit rather than an accountable installation command.

units.function: Pure regression matrix for managed-profile detection, local path canonicalization and bundled-root containment.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls the production guard against temporary directories, files and symlinks without database or route dependencies.
units.keyDataModels: Environment documents, canonical path results and catalog containment decisions.
units.lifecycle: Creates path aliases and escape fixtures, invokes guard functions and cleans all temporary paths.
units.testAssessment: Fifteen focused cases passed and provide high-confidence lexical/realpath regression coverage. Missing adversarial cases concern races and package contents rather than the tested path functions themselves.
units.designRationale: Make the cloud install floor small, deterministic and independently testable.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs this style of fast unit matrix beneath slower end-to-end installation and execution security tests.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT nearly directly with Company OS deployment-profile terminology, stable error codes and additional descriptor/digest/nested-artifact/race cases.
units.responsibilityConflict: The assertions prove path policy only, not who approved installation or what exact content and capabilities were authorized.

units.function: Database-backed route tests for cloud npm denial, bundled local allowlisting, canonical local paths and self-hosted install behavior.
units.dependencyDirection: Exercises Express plugin routes and real Loader/database while mocking lifecycle and activity/live-event side effects.
units.keyDataModels: Instance-admin actor, managed config, install request, temporary executable plugin package and persisted plugin response.
units.lifecycle: Builds packages inside/outside the catalog, posts install requests, verifies response and Loader/lifecycle reachability, then removes fixtures.
units.testAssessment: All thirteen cases skipped locally due embedded-PostgreSQL support. The matrix is valuable but does not test non-admin actors, immutable content, nested escape, manifest execution safety or end-to-end activation/audit.
units.designRationale: Prove the small path guard is actually applied at the public RCE-bearing route across deployment profiles.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS requires a full installation security story from authenticated accountable principal through package trust, approval, persistence, runtime attestation and evidence.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the route matrix with deterministic package-source fakes and real database/runtime contract tests; add actor negatives, digest-bound approval, content swapping, nested paths, rollback and audit projection.
units.responsibilityConflict: Every request uses the same instance admin and activity is mocked, so no responsibility chain or approval evidence is proven; an allowed bundled directory still executes unvalidated manifest code downstream.
